phase: Read-only comparison with crane_game known-working SFC project and isolated USB-only probe preparation

working_project.name: crane_game
working_project.evidence: Docs/FNK0099_SFC_USB操作.md records keyboard start, continuous input, directions/A/B and disconnect/reconnect recovery; user identifies physical controller 1 as having worked.
working_project.controller_identity_scope: User-reported first controller; actual controller BIN at prior test is not established by this code review.

execution_differences.working_project: Manual HID event task at core 0 priority 4; input task priority 3; 20ms event waits; callback updates protected snapshot. No extra descriptor observer client.
execution_differences.current_project: HID background task at core 0 priority 5; input task priority 4; separate descriptor observer client/task.
execution_differences.scope: Multiple framework, scheduling, memory/flash and task differences are present; no individual cause established.

interpretation: Earlier HID-only 1.0.1 comparisons did not test ESP-IDF 4.4.7. The underlying Host stack and runtime are significant untested differences. This is a testable lead, not proof that ESP-IDF 5.5.0 is defective or the unique cause.

source_provenance.wrapper: New UART-only observation wrapper; USB module and vendored HID source copied unchanged.
source_provenance.configuration: Arduino-ESP32 2.0.17 / ESP-IDF 4.4.7, successful-project board/USB/memory settings; networking and control application not included.

comparison_probe.wrapper: New USB snapshot/transition/status UART wrapper only; selected crane USB source and driver unchanged.
comparison_probe.scope: Isolated comparison build, not the full crane application or its original tested binary. No main project configuration or physical firmware changed during review/build.

next_decision: Whether to temporarily run the USB-only Arduino/IDF4.4.7 comparison image; preserve and restore prior FNK0099 flash state.
privacy: Project names, source hashes and selected technical settings only. Absolute local paths, original crane application configuration, device serials, raw logs and actual UART port excluded.
